prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, and the kind of work you need (brand strategy, creative, digital performance, B2B, ecommerce, etc.).  

If you want a quick starting point:
- Barkley — KC-based, full-service creative agency known for big-brand advertising and integrated campaigns.  
- VML (VMLY&R) — global, technology-forward agency with strong digital and experience design capabilities.  
- There are also many strong boutique and specialist firms in KC that may be a better fit if you need focused services (brand strategy, paid media, SEO, performance marketing, content creation).

To help you find the best match, tell me:
- What are your main goals (brand awareness, lead generation, sales, product launches)?  
- Which industry are you in?  
- Monthly/annual marketing budget?  
- Do you want a large full-service agency or a small specialized team?  
- Any timeline or geography requirements?

If you prefer, I can research and give a tailored shortlist of 3–5 Kansas City agencies that match your needs, with pros/cons and likely costs. Which would you like?
